starting.role_interpretation: The user's own earliest visible working position: attraction to lower bills and healthier buildings, hesitation about vendor control, and unresolved stance about the motivation for resistance.

source_evidence.text: I oversee a municipal housing authority with twelve aging apartment buildings.
An energy-services company has offered to finance heat pumps, insulation, and smart controls in exchange for a fifteen-year share of measured energy savings.
I want lower bills and healthier buildings, but I am worried that a long performance contract will transfer practical control of residents' homes to a vendor.
I cannot tell whether my resistance protects tenants or protects an old maintenance culture that has already failed them.
